transcript.content: Hi, I think I added travel insurance to my upcoming flight, but it's not showing up online. My reservation number is PEP4E0. I'm flying with family members and everyone else already has insurance, so I need to make sure I have it too. Can you help me get that added?

Unfortunately, I'm unable to add travel insurance to your reservation. Per our policy, insurance can only be added at the time of initial booking — it cannot be added afterward.

Your reservation PEP4E0 currently does not have insurance, and there's no way for me (or a human agent) to add it at this stage. I'm sorry I can't help with that particular request.

Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Okay, I understand it's a policy limitation. Thanks for checking on that for me.
